compatibilityResearch.question: Whether inverse-object-property axiom operands are order-insensitive while retaining a repeated operand
compatibilityResearch.publicBasis: W3C OWL 2 Structural Specification section 9.2.4 and public OWLAPI API behavior
compatibilityResearch.reason: Source inspection followed public-specification research to resolve a narrow observable compatibility edge case.
compatibilityResearch.productionUse: No implementation text or control flow was copied; the project-owned regression test defines the independently authored behavior.

compatibilityResearch.question: Whether separately created anonymous ontology IDs compare as distinct manager identities
compatibilityResearch.publicBasis: Public OWLOntologyID and OWLOntologyManager API behavior
compatibilityResearch.reason: Source inspection resolved a narrow compatibility question after the plan established that no semantic ontology IRI may be invented.
compatibilityResearch.productionUse: No implementation text or control flow was copied; project-owned model and manager regressions establish the behavior.

compatibilityResearch.question: Whether OWLLiteral exposes its datatype as an OWLDatatype structural entity
compatibilityResearch.publicBasis: W3C OWL 2 literal structure and public OWLAPI LiteralProvider/OWLLiteral APIs
compatibilityResearch.reason: Source search corroborated the public API shape while auditing the independently authored structural model.
compatibilityResearch.productionUse: No implementation text or control flow was copied; the public structural contract and project test define behavior.

compatibilityResearch.question: Which Functional Syntax behaviors are normative grammar requirements and which OWLAPI behaviors are compatibility-only observations
compatibilityResearch.publicBasis: W3C OWL 2 Structural Specification and Functional-Style Syntax Second Edition plus public OWLAPI parser/format APIs
compatibilityResearch.reason: Source inspection was limited to provenance and narrow compatibility research after the W3C grammar and project parser contracts were established; observable results were captured through the pinned Java harness.
compatibilityResearch.productionUse: No implementation text, grammar actions, generated parser structure, or control flow was copied; independently authored production behavior is defined by the W3C specification and project-owned tests.

compatibilityResearch.question: Why OWLAPI 5.5.1 omits an OWL/XML AnonymousIndividual child from ObjectOneOf while retaining the named individual
compatibilityResearch.publicBasis: W3C OWL 2 XML Serialization XML Schema ObjectOneOf and Individual productions plus the pinned OWLAPI behavioral snapshot
compatibilityResearch.reason: Source inspection was restricted to the OneOfEH, AnonEH, and anonymous-individual child dispatch after the W3C grammar and black-box structural divergence were established; it localized the omission to a narrow reference-parser handling gap.
compatibilityResearch.productionUse: No implementation text, handler structure, or control flow was copied; the independently authored parser follows the W3C grammar and the exact project-owned expected-difference rule records the reference behavior.
